entry.title: Quails and Sparrows in an Autumn Scene
entry.blurb: A child prodigy, he was instructed by the great Yuan master Zhao Mengfu at an early age.

source.credit: The Cleveland Museum of Art. Bequest of Mrs. A. Dean Perry

facts: The flower-and-bird subjects here are depicted in a meticulous manner, echoing the academic tradition but translating the customarily colored images to plain monochrome.
Fine ink lines combined with carefully graded washes define the contours and give subtle modeling to the natural forms.
Wang Yuan excelled in flower-and-bird subjects as well as landscape and figure paintings.
